test_pose_multiplication: test Pose.mul() by multiplying two poses and comparing the resulting homogeneous transformation matrix
test_pose_inversion: test Pose.inv() by inverting a pose and verifying the homogeneous matrix matches numpy.linalg.inv
test_pose_stamped_frame_transform: test PoseStamped.to_frame() to transform a pose from world coordinates into a different reference frame
test_vec6_arithmetic: test Vec6 scalar and vector arithmetic operations including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division
test_batched_pose_operations: test batched Pose.mul() and Pose.inv() on arrays of poses with shape (batch, 3) positions
